name: DUMBBELL CRUNCHES
introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands holding a dumbbell. 

Lift your upper body off the floor and raise and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling at the same time. 

Slowly go back to the starting position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a dumbbell and a mat.
Please pause for one second when raising your body up.
Please don\'t let the dumbbell move forward, for doing that will make the exercise easier.
Exhale when raising your body, and inhale when lowering it.
You should feel your abdominal muscles burning.
